children.name: #text

children.name: #text
children.text: Published data modules that have been changed and have the changes indicated within the data module using change elements and attributes, must have the attribute issueType set to the value /changed/ or, if the data module is reinstated, set to /rinstate-changed/. (Chap 3.9.5.1, Para 2.2)

children.name: #text
children.text: Data modules that have been totally revised and that contain no change elements or attributes must have the attribute issueType set to the value /revised/ or, if the data module is reinstated, set to /rinstate-revised/. (Chap 3.9.5.1, Para 2.2)
